description: Source file implementing utility functions for decoding IAMF (Immersive Audio Metadata Format) buffers, including parsing OBU headers, codec configs, audio elements, and mix presentations within the IAMF stream.

classes.name: BufferReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading various data types from a byte buffer, including support for Leb128 encoding, string reading, and byte skipping.

methods.name: ParseOBUHeader
methods.description: Parses an IAMF OBU header to extract the OBU type and size.

methods.name: ParseCodecConfigOBU
methods.description: Parses a codec configuration OBU to extract sample rate and number of samples, supporting Opus and ipcm codecs.

methods.name: CheckForAdvancedAudioElements
methods.description: Checks if an audio element contains binaural or surround layouts and updates corresponding IDs.

methods.name: ParseAudioElementOBU
methods.description: Parses an audio element OBU to extract IDs and layout information, with options for binaural and surround preferences.

methods.name: ParseMixPresentationOBU
methods.description: Parses a mix presentation OBU to determine the presentation ID based on preferences and available audio elements.

methods.name: ParseDescriptorOBU
methods.description: Parses a descriptor OBU, dispatching to specific handlers based on OBU type.

methods.name: IamfBufferInfo::is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the IAMF buffer info contains valid data (has a mix presentation ID, sample rate, and number of samples).

methods.name: ParseInputBuffer
methods.description: Main function to parse an input buffer into IAMF buffer info, handling multiple OBUs and extracting configuration and data sections.
